Supportive organisations

Stack of end-of-life Windows 10 machines you don't know what to do with?

If your organisation is retiring Windows 10 machines, Saved can take them off your hands to avoid them heading to e-waste. Saved will securely format, process, restore, and reimagine them. Saved does sell them for a small fee with profits redirected to training schemes in resilient technologies.

Collection is arranged free of charge. Onsite processing is available for additional security.
